# Mondoc

> A lightweight model-and-service abstraction layer for MongoDB in PHP, by District5. Documents map
> to typed model classes; all querying lives in all-static service classes. An ODM-lite: no
> annotations, no proxies, no unit of work, no code generation. PHP >= 8.2, mongodb/mongodb v2.x.

Composer: `composer require district5/mondoc` — package `district5/mondoc`, PSR-4 root
`District5\Mondoc\` → `src/`.

Three concepts: a **model** (`MondocAbstractModel`, typed properties = document fields, holds `_id`,
can `save()`/`delete()` itself), a **sub-model** (`MondocAbstractSubModel`, an embedded document),
and a **service** (`MondocAbstractService`, all-static, knows the collection name, holds every
query). They are wired together by the `MondocConfig` singleton, which holds the databases, the
model→service map, and an optional field-encryption adapter. **A model missing from the service map
throws `MondocServiceMapErrorException` on first use** — this is the most common integration error.

## Start here

- [Agent reference](./docs/agent-reference.md): complete verified API surface — every service and
  model method with signatures, exact write/hook/dirty-tracking semantics, 20 documented gotchas, and
  corrections where the README has drifted from the code. Read this before writing Mondoc code.
- [CLAUDE.md](./CLAUDE.md): for changing the library itself — architecture, trait layout, invariants,
  test setup, code conventions.
- [README.md](./README.md): human-oriented overview and examples.

## Official documentation site

- [Home](https://mondoc.district5.dev/)
- [Quick start](https://mondoc.district5.dev/quick-start)
- [Documentation index](https://mondoc.district5.dev/documentation)
- [Source browser](https://mondoc.district5.dev/src)

### Configuration

- [Configuration](https://mondoc.district5.dev/documentation/configuration): the `MondocConfig`
  singleton, multiple named connections, the service map
- [Converting types](https://mondoc.district5.dev/documentation/converting-types): `MondocTypes` —
  BSON ↔ PHP, dates, ObjectIds

### Model

- [Model](https://mondoc.district5.dev/documentation/model): properties, inflation, `asArray()`,
  `asJsonEncodableArray()`, `assignDefaultVars()`
- [Nested models](https://mondoc.district5.dev/documentation/model/nested-models): `$mondocNested`,
  single vs `[]` arrays of sub-models
- [Model traits](https://mondoc.district5.dev/documentation/model/traits): created/modified dates,
  revision numbers, model versioning, cloning, retention
- [Field aliases](https://mondoc.district5.dev/documentation/model/field-aliases):
  `$mondocFieldAliases` — short database keys, long property names
- [Field encryption](https://mondoc.district5.dev/documentation/model/field-encryption):
  `$mondocEncrypted` and the Sodium adapters
- [Field encryption with aliases](https://mondoc.district5.dev/documentation/model/advanced-field-encryption-with-aliases)
- [Data retention](https://mondoc.district5.dev/documentation/model/data-retention): automatic change
  history via `MondocRetentionTrait`
- [Lifecycle hooks](https://mondoc.district5.dev/documentation/model/lifecycle-hooks):
  `beforeInsert`/`afterInsert`/`beforeUpdate`/`afterUpdate`/`beforeDelete`/`afterDelete`

### Service

- [Service](https://mondoc.district5.dev/documentation/service): `getCollectionName()`,
  `getConnectionId()`, reads, writes, deletes
- [Query scopes](https://mondoc.district5.dev/documentation/service/query-scopes): `getScopes()`,
  `scope()`, `mergeFilters()`
- [Pagination](https://mondoc.district5.dev/documentation/service/pagination): page-number and
  ObjectId-cursor strategies via `MondocPaginationHelper`
- [Atomic operations](https://mondoc.district5.dev/documentation/service/atomic-operations):
  `inc`/`dec`/`incMulti`/`decMulti`
- [Array operators](https://mondoc.district5.dev/documentation/service/array-operators): `$push` and
  `$pull` helpers
- [Aggregation](https://mondoc.district5.dev/documentation/service/aggregation): `aggregate()` —
  average, sum, min, max, percentile, financial candles and SMA

### Query building

- [Query building](https://mondoc.district5.dev/documentation/query-building): the
  `district5/mondoc-builder` `QueryBuilder` and its `QueryTypes\*` parts
- [Advanced queries](https://mondoc.district5.dev/documentation/query-building/advanced-queries)

## Related packages

- [district5/mondoc-builder](https://github.com/district-5/php-mondoc-builder) — `District5\MondocBuilder\`, query building
- [district5/mondoc-encryption](https://github.com/district-5/php-mondoc-encryption) — `District5\MondocEncryption\`, field encryption adapters
- [district5/date](https://github.com/district-5/php-date) — `District5\Date\`, date creation and manipulation
